name: Equalizer Wipe
description: The second clip rises from the bottom in vertical bars that bounce like an audio equalizer, lit in segments and topped by falling peak caps, until they fill the frame. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: bars
params.description: Number of bars across the frame

params.name: bounce
params.description: How far the bars bounce above and below their average level, in frame heights

params.name: segments
params.description: Number of lit segments in a bar the height of the frame (0 for solid bars)

params.name: cap_color
params.description: Color of the peak caps (alpha: opacity)
